description: Golden outputs captured verbatim from the real codebase-memory-mcp binary against tests/fixtures/cbm_sample_repo. No mocked content. The CBM database itself is NOT committed.
receipts: No tool failed with the real binary 0.10.8; all seven captures exited 0.

detect_changes resolves git context from the project root's enclosing repository (the parent sot-graph checkout); its output is environment-dependent (base branch + merge_base) and must be re-captured if the parent repo state changes.

Wire-format quirk (binary 0.10.8): list-valued flags via --flag do not arrive as arrays server-side; check_index_coverage recorded the entire JSON array string as a single requested_path. Adapter work should prefer --args-file for array arguments.

Digests (G1.3): capture_command_digest = sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':')) of captures[] as {file,argv,cwd} in listed order; fixture_repo_digest = sha256 over the git-tracked sample-repo files (git ls-files tests/fixtures/cbm_sample_repo, sorted, each 'path:sha256(content)' newline-joined) — recomputable from a clean clone.
